items.name: theme
items.title: Ndigo theme
items.description: Ndigo brand tokens (--nd-*) plus the opt-in base layer for native elements.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Import `styles/ndigo-tokens.css` before the base layer. Set `data-theme="light"` for the light palette; leaving it unset follows the operating system.

items.name: lib
items.title: Ndigo element foundation
items.description: Shared light-DOM custom-element base and the Zag.js machine controller.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy-in foundation for `<nd-*>` elements: the `NdElement` lifecycle base and `createZagElement`.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog with focus trapping, dismissal, and ARIA wiring from the Zag.js dialog machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with roving highlight, typeahead, and dismissal from the Zag.js menu machine.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Native-first button styles with variants and sizes; no runtime and no custom element.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-button` to a native `<button>` (or `<a href>` for navigation). Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger; sizes: sm, md, lg.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Responsive application frame with a skip link, banner, primary nav, sidebar, main landmark, and footer.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Copy the markup into a layout and replace the `<main>` contents; keep the skip link first and the landmarks unique.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Native text inputs and textareas with focus, disabled, and invalid states.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-input` to a native `<input>` and `nd-textarea` to a `<textarea>`; pair with a `label` and `aria-describedby`.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, help, and error scaffolding for native form controls.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Wrap a labelled control in `nd-field`; use `nd-label`, `nd-help`, and `nd-error`, and `aria-invalid` for the state.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox and radio
items.description: Native checkboxes and radios with the brand accent, focus, and choice-group layout.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: Apply `nd-checkbox`/`nd-radio` to native controls; use `nd-choice` rows and a `nd-choice-group` fieldset.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Non-modal overlay with a trigger, positioned surface, title/description, close, and arrow.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-popover>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hint surface with hover/focus delays, arrow, and aria-describedby wiring.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-tooltip>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tablist, roving focus, arrow navigation, and tabpanels.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-tabs>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Expandable items with single/multiple and collapsible modes.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-accordion>` — see the item README for parts, events, and keyboard behaviour.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Labelled toggle with a hidden checkbox and the ARIA switch contract.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-switch>` builds the label/input/control/thumb from text markup; emits `nd-checked-change`.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value range with track, range, thumb, and keyboard steps.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-slider>` provides track/range/thumb parts, `setValue()`, and keyboard steps; emits `nd-value-change`.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Single transient notification with live-region semantics and auto-dismiss.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-toast>` is a native-first live region with `show()`/`hide()` and an optional duration; emits `nd-open-change`.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Single-select dropdown with a hidden native select and listbox options.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-select>` derives its collection from `[data-part="item"][data-value]` markup; see the item README.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable single-select with an input, listbox, and filtered collection.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-combobox>` derives its collection from `[data-part="item"][data-value]` markup; see the item README.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge-anchored dialog with end, start, bottom, and top placement.
items.author: Ndigo <https://ndigo.dev>
items.docs: `<nd-drawer>` shares the dialog machine; set `placement` to `end`, `start`, `bottom`, or `top`.
